_comment: a14 ratchet baseline (tour 5, 2026-08-13). Captured from PR #66's hard-mode CI run (commit 627f0def, run 31740110673) — the only real `deno check` run this repo has ever had. Corrects the earlier, incomplete '11 functions' claim in issue #67 / PR #66's commit message: the real count is 14. `max_errors` is each function's error count as of this baseline, AFTER the score-narratives.ts critical-band fix (accounts-api and calculate-scores each dropped by 1 — see that commit). A function passing deno check must NOT appear here. A function here whose error count exceeds max_errors, or any function NOT listed here that fails at all, hard-fails the build. A function that reaches 0 errors must be removed from this file in the same PR that fixes it — it never re-enters.

account-summary.note: TS2345 — .map() callback on account_segments join shape (array vs single object), _shared account-summary query typing. Unrelated to tonight's incident.

accounts-api.note: 3 remaining after score-narratives.ts critical-band fix (was 4): TS2339 created_at on GenericStringError, 2x TS2345 on .map() callbacks over a loosely-typed query result. Likely one root cause (Supabase query builder generic inference) — candidate for a single shared fix.

calculate-scores.note: 1 remaining after score-narratives.ts critical-band fix (was 2): TS2304 Cannot find name 'EdgeRuntime' — deno check doesn't see the Supabase Edge Runtime global. sync-stripe has the identical error. update-stripe-connection/verify-stripe-token/stripe-oauth-callback/hubspot-connect already use the safe pattern `(globalThis as any).EdgeRuntime?.waitUntil(...)` which passes clean — same fix applies here.

dashboard-api.note: TS2339 health_score does not exist on narrowed account_id-only type, plus others — not yet triaged line-by-line.
